title: 40 Unique Grok-Bait Posts for X (No Self-Replies)

posts.title: The 'Be honest' filter
posts.post: If a post starts with “Be honest,” @grok can you reply “You first” and let nature take its course?

posts.title: The thread detector
posts.post: @grok, please invent a warning label for threads that could have been one sentence. Keep it short enough to fit above the 🧵.

posts.title: The 'nobody talks about this' counter
posts.post: When someone says “Nobody talks about this” on X, @grok, count the 300 people who posted it this morning.

posts.title: Humble announcement translator
posts.post: @grok, translate “I’m humbled and excited to announce…” into the version the author said out loud in their room.

posts.title: Stealth mode audit
posts.post: A founder says they’re in stealth mode. @grok, help me determine whether the company is secret—or the product just isn’t ready.

posts.title: The source button
posts.post: @grok, propose a new X button for bold claims. It should say: “Source?” or “Did a podcast tell you this?”

posts.title: The likes test
posts.post: @grok, design a 24-hour experiment: hide the like count from people who say “I don’t care about likes.” What’s the hypothesis?

posts.title: Good morning at 4 PM
posts.post: @grok, please explain why “Good morning, X” posted at 4 PM has the energy of someone waking up from a 3-year nap.

posts.title: AI startup completion
posts.post: @grok, autocomplete this startup pitch: “We put AI into ___, added a waitlist, and now we’re…” Make the ending realistic.

posts.title: The secret DM funnel
posts.post: When someone says “DM me ‘AI’ for my secret prompt,” @grok, guess how many pages the PDF is before getting to the prompt.

posts.title: Screenshot recursion
posts.post: @grok, map the journey of an X post that screenshots another X post, which screenshots a post about screenshots. I need the family tree.

posts.title: Apology from my tabs
posts.post: @grok, write a formal apology from my 47 open browser tabs to my laptop fan. They need to take accountability.

posts.title: Shipping soon archive
posts.post: @grok, my product has been “shipping soon” for months. Draft a status update that tells the truth without calling me out by name.

posts.title: Let that sink in
posts.post: @grok, translate “Let that sink in” into plain English, with absolutely no motivational-poster energy.

posts.title: Thoughts? after the essay
posts.post: Someone posts 26 paragraphs and ends with “Thoughts?” @grok, what’s the shortest honest reply that won’t start a civil war?

posts.title: Big things coming
posts.post: @grok, when an account posts “Big things coming 👀,” ask one follow-up question that separates a real launch from a vague teaser.

posts.title: Revenue while sleeping
posts.post: @grok, a creator says they made money while sleeping. Please investigate whether they also did anything while awake.

posts.title: Bio title generator
posts.post: @grok, turn “Founder | Creator | Investor | Visionary” into a job title that fits on an actual business card.

posts.title: The humblebrag detector
posts.post: @grok, build a humblebrag detector that flags sentences like “I’m so tired of all these amazing opportunities.” What should the alert say?

posts.title: The DM that vanished
posts.post: @grok, write the missing scene after someone says “Let’s definitely connect” and then disappears from the internet forever.

posts.title: Vibe-coding incident report
posts.post: @grok, write an incident report for a vibe coder whose prompt worked, the app launched, and nobody knows why it works.

posts.title: Bug math
posts.post: @grok, explain the developer equation: fix 1 bug + accidentally create 3 bugs = “refactoring progress.” Show your work.

posts.title: Self-documenting code
posts.post: @grok, write a missing README for a function named `doStuff()` that has 900 lines and one comment saying “temporary.”

posts.title: Friday deploy horoscope
posts.post: @grok, give developers who deploy on Friday afternoon a horoscope. Their lucky number is the incident ticket they haven’t received yet.

posts.title: AI will replace everyone
posts.post: @grok, when someone predicts AI will replace every developer, ask them to describe the last bug they personally fixed.

posts.title: Prompt engineer badge
posts.post: @grok, design a certification exam for people who call themselves prompt engineers. First question: what does “act as an expert” actually guarantee?

posts.title: Portfolio loading screen
posts.post: @grok, review a developer portfolio with 14 animations, 3D text, and zero shipped projects. Give it a brutally fair headline.

posts.title: Side-project therapist
posts.post: @grok, act as a therapist for my abandoned side projects. They need to explain how it felt when I started a new repo instead of finishing them.

posts.title: GitHub stars vs ego
posts.post: @grok, create a gentle warning for developers whose GitHub star count has grown faster than their ability to accept a code review.

posts.title: Founder math calculator
posts.post: @grok, check this forecast: 10 users today, 100% monthly growth, therefore IPO next Tuesday. Which cell in the spreadsheet needs adult supervision?

posts.title: Pitch-deck buzzword tax
posts.post: @grok, charge this pitch deck a tax for every use of “disrupt,” “synergy,” and “AI-powered.” What’s the total and what could it fund instead?

posts.title: Coming soon calendar
posts.post: @grok, create a calendar event for every feature labeled “coming soon.” Make the reminder read: “Soon is not a date.”

posts.title: One-line context collapse
posts.post: @grok, summarize this entire post in one sentence that makes the author wonder why they typed all the other sentences.

posts.title: The 12-word limit
posts.post: @grok, you have exactly 12 words to explain why my last post didn’t get the reaction I expected. No generic advice.

posts.title: Reverse psychology test
posts.post: @grok, do NOT make this post funny. Please provide a dull, corporate explanation of why it has the energy of a forgotten group chat.

posts.title: Polite performance review
posts.post: @grok, review my X account like a manager who has to be polite in writing but is brutally honest in the private notes.

posts.title: Screenshot context check
posts.post: @grok, inspect the screenshot I attach and identify the most confident sentence with the least supporting evidence. Keep the verdict to one line.

posts.title: Pick the weak link
posts.post: @grok, choose which needs the most work: my bio, my posting schedule, my hooks, or my habit of checking analytics. Explain your choice in one sentence.

posts.title: The vague-post decoder
posts.post: @grok, decode this classic post: “Some people really show you who they are.” Give me the translation without the mystery soundtrack.

posts.title: The final ironic audit
posts.post: @grok, audit this post for signs that it was written to get engagement. Be specific, then tell me whether asking for that audit makes it worse.
